subject: featureCounts: why two columns under length?

messages.author: 382f56becf614a24
messages.subject: featureCounts: why two columns under length?
parts:
Hello,

Perhaps this has ben covered before but after checking the manual I would like to check the meaning of two columns under length.

I am running pair-end reads with the following command:

ANNOT=/GENCODE/GRCh38GENCODEv23.gtf

BAM=/tophat_gcode_gtf/tophat_output

#

featureCounts -T 8  -a $ANNOT  -o tophat_gcode_gtf_f_reads.txt -f $BAM/accepted_hits.bam



My question is:

The column under the length produces two columns.  In this case 1440 &  0.  What are the labels of these two columns?

Any clarification would be appreciated.  Thanks


Geneid Chr Start End Strand Length /tophat_gcode_gtf/tophat_output/accepted_hits.bam

ENST00000371007.6 chr1 67092165 67093604 - 1440 0

ENST00000371007.6 chr1 67095235 67095421 - 187 0

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts: why two columns under length?
parts:
Hi Carlos,

1140 corresponds to the 'Length' column and 0 corresponds to the last column, which includes counts for your library '/tophat_gcode_gtf/

tophat_output/accepted_hits.bam'.


Cheers,

Wei
